integerSemantics.word: u32 modulo 2^32; interpreted as two's-complement i32 only for signed ordering
integerSemantics.lcg: state=(state*1664525+1013904223) modulo 2^32; seed is the input i32 bit pattern
integerSemantics.remainder: workload value generation applies signed-i32 C/JavaScript remainder; Fisher-Yates alone applies unsigned-u32 modulo
integerSemantics.fnv: h=2166136261; for each logical i32 word h=(h xor wordBits)*16777619 modulo 2^32
integerSemantics.shifts: logical u32 shifts with count masked by 31
integerSemantics.layout: logical u32 and binary64 elements; any serialized representation is fixed little-endian

workloads.inputLayout: A[N] then B[N] logical i32; A=(LCG%17)-8, B=(LCG%13)-6
X[N] then Y[N] logical i32; X=(LCG%11)-5, Y=(LCG%9)-4
workloads.roi: update Y followed by its FNV oracle reduction

workloads.inputLayout: source[N] LCG words then zeroed destination[N]
workloads.oracle: FNV over destination words after ordered copy
workloads.roi: copy loop followed by destination FNV reduction

workloads.inputLayout: row-major A[N*N], B[N*N], zero C[N*N]; inputs=(LCG%7)-3
workloads.oracle: FNV over row-major C from ordered ijk wrapping i32 GEMM
workloads.roi: complete ijk GEMM followed by C FNV reduction

workloads.oracle: FNV over stable ascending signed-i32 insertion sort result
workloads.roi: in-place insertion sort followed by FNV reduction

workloads.inputLayout: sorted values[N]=LCG%10000 then keys[N]; each third key is LCG%10000, others values[i]
workloads.oracle: wrapping sum of exact midpoint-hit indices, or -1 when absent
workloads.roi: all ordered binary searches and index accumulation

workloads.inputLayout: N+1 logical u32 marks initialized to one
workloads.oracle: count of primes less than or equal to N
each round xor i, rotate-left 5, add 0x9e3779b9, xor logical-right 7

seed.meaning: Fisher-Yates LCG state and payload addend

workloads.inputLayout: next-index[N] cycle equivalent to built-in pointer links; payload(i)=i*17+seed
workloads.oracle: wrapping payload sum walking N links from node zero
workloads.roi: dependent link walk and payload accumulation

workloads.inputLayout: X[N]=(LCG%21)-10; fixed taps [1,-2,3,-1,2,1,-1,1]; zero left padding
workloads.oracle: wrapping ordered sum of all 8-tap wrapping outputs
workloads.roi: all convolution loops and output accumulation

workloads.oracle: exact raw bits of strict source-order IEEE-754 binary64 additions from +0
